dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Three prominent irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped structures are visible in the upper-left quadrant of the torso. These exhibit jagged, high-contrast light-grey perimeters. The pixel gradient transitions sharply from the low-intensity dark substrate to the high-intensity perimeter line, followed by a decrease in intensity toward the dark interior cores.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: A moderate density of small, solid high-intensity white pixel clusters is localized in the interstitial regions between the primary macro-annuli. These clusters are typically 5-15 pixels in diameter and lack internal intensity variations, appearing as bright, singular points against the dark base.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest macro-annuli in the upper-left quadrant form a scalene triangle. The vertex located at the topmost centroid is acute (approximately 40 degrees), with the longest side of the triangle connecting the topmost and bottommost centroids.

other_distinctive_markers: A fine, high-contrast reticulated pattern of thin filaments creates a mesh-like texture across the dorsal mid-section, interconnecting several isolated annuli.
